quotes.text: Co-pilot doesn't create this exposure, but it makes that data discoverable by meaning instead of by accident.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Captures why old over-permissioning becomes acute with semantic search.

quotes.text: Conditional access is just an access gate. It controls who gets to open the door. But once you're through that door, co-pilot shows you everything your permissions grant.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clears up the common confusion between access control at sign-in and data exposure.

quotes.text: The visibility co-pilot creates is actually a feature. You aren't exposing secrets. You're exposing what was broken all along.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Reframes a Copilot rollout as a catalyst for fixing permission debt.

quotes.text: The truth is that organizations deploying Copilot are not solving an AI problem. They are uncovering a governance problem that has been sitting there for years.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: States the episode's core thesis in one line.

quotes.text: Every time an agent gets a new capability, the blast radius of a successful injection attack grows.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains why agentic capabilities raise the stakes of prompt injection.

takeaways: Copilot does not create new access rights; it makes years of over-permissioning discoverable by meaning, so permission cleanup has to come before rollout.
Treat Copilot as a privileged resource: phishing-resistant MFA, risk-based conditional access, continuous access evaluation and dedicated agent identities in Entra.
Layer sensitivity labels, upstream Purview DLP, Sentinel-based response and long audit retention into one continuous governance model rather than a one-time setup.
hook: Most organizations believe their existing permissions keep Microsoft 365 Copilot safe, but the semantic index turns every permission mistake into an answer. This episode gives security architects and Microsoft 365 admins a five-layer framework covering identity, agent governance, data classification, DLP and detection to deploy Copilot without flying blind.
